answer_1.quote: We conduct comprehensive evaluations on various generation tasks. MT-Bench for multi-turn conversation; GSM8K for mathematical reasoning; HumanEval, MBPP and ClassEval for code generation; and we also evaluate on CNN/DailyMail and XSum summarization datasets.

answer_2.quote: SPECTRA Decoding produces ROUGE-1, ROUGE-2, and ROUGE-L scores on both the CNN/DailyMail and XSum summarization datasets that are nearly identical to those of standard autoregressive sampling.
